```{r unvalidated IDs}

# 1. Set the path to your main umbrella directory
main_directory <- here('SSL Perinatal Project', 'data')

# 2. Recursively find every .xlsx file in all subfolders
excel_files <- dir_ls(main_directory, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*.xlsx")

# 3. Read them all and bind them together
combined_data <- excel_files %>% 
  # map_df loops through each file path, reads it, and stacks them up.
  # .id = "source_file" creates a brand-new column containing the file path!
  map_df(~ read_excel(.x), .id = "source_file") %>% 
  mutate(date = make_date(year, month, day)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(AnimalID = animalid, SiteName = sitename, Year = year, Behavior = behavior) %>%
  dplyr::select(brand, AnimalID, SiteName, Year, date, Behavior)

unread_IDs <- combined_data %>% dplyr::select(brand, AnimalID) %>% distinct() %>% filter(!is.na(AnimalID))

dat <- combined_data %>% 
  merge(unread_IDs %>% dplyr::rename(ID_missing = AnimalID), by = (c('brand'))) %>%
  mutate(AnimalID_corr = coalesce(AnimalID, ID_missing)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(ID_missing, AnimalID)) %>%
  rename(AnimalID = AnimalID_corr)

```



```{r tidy data}

#branding data
inits_raw <- read.csv(here::here('SSL Perinatal Project','data', "initial_capture_data_111322.csv"), 
                  header = T, stringsAsFactors = F) %>%
  filter(Region %in% c('C ALEU', 'C GULF', 'E ALEU', 'E GULF', 'SE AK', 'W ALEU', 'W GULF')) %>%
  filter(Region != 'SE AK') %>%
  dplyr::select(AnimalID, Brand, SiteName, Year, Sex, AdjustedSex, Age, Mass_kg, date, Region)

inits_recent <- read.csv(here::here ('SSL Perinatal Project', 'data', "initial_capture_data_012125.csv"), 
                  header = T, stringsAsFactors = F) %>%
  filter(Region %in% c('C ALEU', 'C GULF', 'E ALEU', 'E GULF', 'SE AK', 'W ALEU', 'W GULF')) %>%
  filter(Region != 'SE AK') %>%
  dplyr::select(AnimalID, Brand, SiteName, Year, Sex, AdjustedSex, Age, Mass_kg, date, Region)

inits <- bind_rows(inits_raw, inits_recent) %>%
  transform(Sex = ifelse(!is.na(AdjustedSex), AdjustedSex, Sex)) %>%
  dplyr::select(AnimalID, Year, Region, SiteName, Sex, Age, 
                Mass_kg) %>%
  dplyr::rename(branding_age = Age) %>%
  transform(Mass_kg = ifelse(is.na(Mass_kg), NA, Mass_kg)) %>% #fill in any NAs (0)
  filter(SiteName != 'CHISWELL ISLANDS') %>%
  filter(Sex == 'F')

#resight data
res_raw <- read.csv(here::here('SSL Perinatal Project', 'data', 'SSL_resights_073025.csv'), 
                     header = T, stringsAsFactors = F) %>%
  transform(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  transform(year = year(date)) %>%
  filter(year > 2014)

np_codes <- c('NP', 'NPJ')
wp_codes <- c('WP', 'WPJ')
pup_yes <- c(np_codes, wp_codes)

# res_merge <- res_raw %>%
  
#parsing fails for rows with a blank 'Time' - doesn't matter
res_remote <- res_raw %>%
  # filter(AnimalID == '15907') %>%
  filter(Age == 'A') %>%
  dplyr::select(AnimalID, date, Time, Behavior, year) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as_date(date),
    month = month(date, label = TRUE),
    day = day(date),
    timestamp = ymd_hms(paste(date, Time, sep = ' '))) %>%
  dplyr::select(!c(Time, year)) %>%
  merge(dat, by = c('AnimalID', 'date'), all = T) %>%
  mutate(Behavior = coalesce(Behavior.x, Behavior.y)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Behavior.x, Behavior.y)) %>%
  mutate(pup_y = if_else(Behavior %in% pup_yes, 1, 0)) %>%
  rename(year = Year) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AnimalID), !is.na(year)) %>%
  group_by(AnimalID, year) %>%
  filter(any(Behavior %in% np_codes, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

min_day <- min(res_remote$timestamp, na.rm = T)
max_day <- max(res_remote$timestamp, na.rm = T)
min_year <- min(res_remote$year)
max_year <- max(res_remote$year)

day_fill <- tibble(
  date = seq(from = min_day, to = max_day, by = "day")) %>%
  mutate(year  = year(date),
    month = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    day   = day(date))

first_pup <- res_remote %>%
  # rename(year = Year) %>%
  filter(pup_y == 1) %>%
  group_by(AnimalID, year) %>%
  summarise(
    first_pup_date = min(date, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Convert to a clean date format (dropping hours/minutes)
  mutate(first_pup = as_date(first_pup_date))

# Get all active females and the years they were seen
active_females <- res_remote %>%
  distinct(AnimalID, year)

# Generate a row for every calendar day of the season for every female
grid <- active_females %>%
  left_join(day_fill, by = "year", relationship = 'many-to-many') %>%
  filter(month %in% c('May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug')) %>%
  mutate(clean_date = make_date(year, match(month, month.abb), day))

res_complete <- grid %>%
  left_join(res_remote, by = c("AnimalID", "year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(first_pup, by = c("AnimalID", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    # If Behavior is NA, she was absent (present = 0), otherwise 1
    present = if_else(is.na(Behavior), 0, 1),
    # Populate the date column using our complete, reconstructed date
    date = clean_date
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, month, day, date, AnimalID, present, pup_y, first_pup) %>%
  # merge(inits %>% dplyr::select(AnimalID, SiteName, Region), by = c('AnimalID'))
  filter(month %in% c('May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug'))

#just observations from first_pup to first_pup + 20 for inds in first_pup
bf <- first_pup$AnimalID

res_pp <- res_complete %>%
  group_by(year, AnimalID) %>%
  filter(date >= first_pup, 
    date <= first_pup + 20) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(AnimalID %in% bf)
  

##to-do: merge with inits for region/sitename referencing

  # Keep only the rows from the birth day onward
 # filter(
  #  !is.na(first_pup),
  #  date >= first_pup
  #) %>%
  # Count the daily streak before the first zero absence
  #summarise(
  #  first_pup = min(first_pup),
   # days_before_absence = if_else(
    #  any(present == 0), 
    #  match(0, present) - 1, 
    #  n()
  #  ),
  #  .groups = "drop"
 # ) %>%
 # merge(inits %>% dplyr::select(AnimalID, SiteName, Region), by = c('AnimalID'), all.x = T) %>%
  #filter(!is.na(Region)) #get rid of individuals not in "inits"

  attendance_summary <- res_pp %>%
  group_by(AnimalID, year) %>%
  filter(!is.na(first_pup), date >= first_pup) %>%
  summarise(
    first_pup = min(first_pup),
    # Streak ends ONLY when 2 consecutive missing days (0, 0) occur
    days_before_absence = {
      p <- present
      two_zeros <- which(p[-length(p)] == 0 & p[-1] == 0)
      if (length(two_zeros) > 0) {
        two_zeros[1] - 1
      } else {
        length(p)
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(inits %>% dplyr::select(AnimalID, SiteName, Region), by = 'AnimalID') %>%
  filter(!is.na(Region))
```

```{r tidy model data}
# 1. STANDARDIZE EVENT CODES FOR MULTIEVENT MODEL

# State-based Event Mapping (c):
# 0 = Not Detected / No Camera Effort in that hour
# 1 = Detected on land, NO PUP or UNKNOWN/AMBIGUOUS PUP STATUS
# 2 = Detected on land, Confirmed WITH Pup (NP, NPJ, WP, WPJ)

obs_clean <- res_remote %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure correct POSIXct format for 1-hour binning
    ts = if ("timestamp" %in% names(.)) {
      timestamp
    } else {
      as.POSIXct(date, tz = "UTC")
    },
    
    # Floor timestamps to 1-hour resolution
    time_bin = floor_date(ts, unit = "1 hour"),
    
    # Hierarchical event assignment for individual photo frames:
    # Priority: Confirmed Pup (2) > Detected on land with No Pup/Unknown (1)
    event_code_raw = case_when(
      Behavior %in% pup_yes ~ 2,
      TRUE                  ~ 1  # Female detected, but No Pup or Unknown
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_bin), !is.na(AnimalID))



# 2. AGGREGATE TO 1-HOUR BINS & IDENTIFY INITIAL BIRTH WINDOWS

obs_1hr <- obs_clean %>%
  group_by(AnimalID, year, time_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    # Pick highest certainty event code if multiple photos occur within the hour
    # If ANY photo in that hour has a verified pup, code = 2; otherwise code = 1
    event_code = case_when(
      any(event_code_raw == 2) ~ 2,
      TRUE                     ~ 1
    ),
    n_photos = n(), # Sampling effort covariate
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

# Calculate initial birth timestamp (t0) per female-year
female_birth_t0 <- obs_1hr %>%
  filter(event_code == 2) %>%
  group_by(AnimalID, year) %>%
  summarise(
    t0_birth = min(time_bin),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )


# 3. CONSTRUCT PERINATAL TIME GRID (-48h pre-birth to +22d post-birth)

# Setting the post-birth window to 22 days (576 hours total) ensures all long-fasting females in E ALEU and C/W ALEU are fully captured

grid_perinatal_1hr <- female_birth_t0 %>%
  group_by(AnimalID, year) %>%
  reframe(
    time_bin = seq(
      from = t0_birth - hours(48),   # 48 hours pre-first pup sighting
      to   = t0_birth + days(22),     # 22 days post-first pup sighting
      by   = "1 hour"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(AnimalID, year) %>%
  mutate(hour_step = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()


# 4. JOIN GRID & BUILD HMM CAPTURE HISTORIES

ch_perinatal_long <- grid_perinatal_1hr %>%
  left_join(obs_1hr, by = c("AnimalID", "year", "time_bin")) %>%
  mutate(
    event_code = replace_na(event_code, 0), # 0 = Not seen / At Sea
    n_photos   = replace_na(n_photos, 0),   # Camera offline / zero photos
    ind_year   = paste(AnimalID, year, sep = "_")
  )

# Extract Format for 'marked' or HMM Likelihood Maximization
# Long-format character histories (ch)
ch_marked_format <- ch_perinatal_long %>%
  group_by(ind_year, AnimalID, year) %>%
  summarise(
    ch = paste0(event_code, collapse = ""),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(inits %>% select(AnimalID, Region, SiteName), by = "AnimalID")

# Observation Matrix (Rows = Female-Year, Columns = Hour_1..576)
y_matrix_perinatal <- ch_perinatal_long %>%
  select(ind_year, hour_step, event_code) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = hour_step, 
    names_prefix = "h_", 
    values_from = event_code
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ind_year") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Effort / Photo Count Matrix (Covariate Matrix)
effort_matrix_perinatal <- ch_perinatal_long %>%
  select(ind_year, hour_step, n_photos) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = hour_step, 
    names_prefix = "h_", 
    values_from = n_photos
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ind_year") %>%
  as.matrix()
```
